name: My Team Macarena Wing - Red Bull Style
author: UnorthodoxStoneNDmodding
description: Adds a Red Bull-style Macarena rear-wing animation to 2026 My Team cars, with reverse 160-degree rotation and adjustable visual travel time from 0 to 500 ms. Animation speed can be changed during play without affecting car performance or liveries. Version 1.0.0 will use Swofty bindings once they are implemented.

options.label: Visual wing travel (ms)
options.description: Approximate time for full visual travel. Higher is slower; 0 disables added smoothing. Updates during play from this session's launcher profile, normally within 250 ms. Changes the rendered rear flaps only; the simulation's aero transition keeps its existing speed.
